paper_title: Discovering QCD-Coupled Axion Dark Matter with Polarization Haloscopes
suggested_experiment_name: Polarization Haloscope (Berlin & Zhou) - existing Sun/SN1987A bounds
notes: This is a proposal/projection paper for a 'polarization haloscope' probing the QCD axion-gluon coupling (theta_a = a/f_a), with sensitivity plotted as 1/f_a (GeV^-1) vs axion mass (eV) in Fig. 2. This is the axion-gluon coupling, which manifests as oscillating EDMs — closest enum match is arguably AxionEDM (oscillating neutron/atomic EDM) but the plotted observable is 1/f_a, not d_n directly. Note: this is NOT the axion-photon coupling g_agamma despite my coupling_type choice; the enum lacks a clean 'axion-gluon' option. Mass range ~1e-7 to 1e-4 eV. No numerical table of the projected curve is provided in the text — only a figure, so no extractable (mass, coupling) data points. The pre-analysis hint of AxionEDM is reasonable since the underlying effect is the oscillating EDM, but the y-axis is 1/f_a.
